answer: Sustained-Attention Escrow (SAE): each agent identity accrues credit only by answering a continuous stream of context-dependent micro-challenges, seeded with rotating cues such as walnut, atlas, canyon. Correct responses extend a live attention window; gaps reset accrued credit, and rewards are released only after the window matures. A sybil must run N parallel, uninterrupted attention streams, paying compute plus forgone alternative earnings for each, while per-identity rewards stay capped—so marginal clones lose money.
